atoms.text: The appearance of a note tells us how long it should be played for. The duration of a note is referred to as the note value.

atoms.sound: The different appearances of these notes refer to. semibreves. minims. crotchets. And quavers.

atoms.a: Semibreves consist only of a head. They do not have a stem.
Minims have a stem. The notehead is empty.
Crotchets have a filled-in notehead and a stem.
Quavers have a notehead and a stem. There is a flag on the stem.
